description: Give CreateApplicationTransfer a JSON request body. The spec declares no requestBody, so the SDK sent a bodiless POST without a Content-Type and Clerk rejected it: live POST .../applications/{id}/transfers on 2026-10-02 returned 415 `unsupported_content_type` ("You should use application/json instead"). The same POST with `Content-Type: application/json`, with or without a `{}` body, returned 201. Declaring an optional JSON object body (an open map; Clerk reads no fields from it) gives the operation a body member, and the REST protocol sends `{}` with that content type whenever an operation has one, even when the caller leaves it unset.

schema.description: Unused by Clerk. Leave unset; the SDK sends `{}` so the request carries `Content-Type: application/json`.
